mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to historical averages compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low-FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or the correlation between UNRATE rise and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL) and elevated interest rates (FEDFUNDS) signal a monetary policy tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in the condition (CPIAUCSL>325 and FEDFUNDS>3.5%) are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in the quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) signals an impending economic slowdown that triggers equity market corrections, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when GDPC1 declines, or the decline in GDPC1 is not associated with negative returns (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO) relative to historical averages indicates robust manufacturing and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in high-INDPRO periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200.0 thousand units over a 3-month window signals weakening consumer demand for durable goods and housing, which reduces corporate revenue growth expectations and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1200.0 in 3 months, or the correlation between HOUST decline and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 325) and declining housing starts (HOUST < 1200.0) signal a confluence of monetary tightening and weakening consumer demand, which compresses profit margins and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in the condition (CPIAUCSL>325 and HOUST<1200.0) are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In strong labor market regimes, robust payroll employment growth (PAYEMS) above 0.5% over a 3-month window supports consumer spending and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in strong labor market periods (PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
